title: Working Student (m/f/d) - AI Engineering
description: At 5Plus (part of Pentadoc Group), we build production-grade AI systems that solve real operational problems for our customers. As a Working Student - AI Engineering , you will help design, build, and deploy AI applications - from LLM-powered workflows (e.g., intelligent document processing) to agentic systems that integrate deeply into our customers' business processes. You'll work hands-on alongside experienced engineers and take on real responsibility from day one. This role is hybrid (remote + Würzburg) and fits flexibly around your studies. Your daily business Build and ship features for AI systems, from prototype to production Develop LLM-powered applications (incl. RAG, tool usage, validations) with a focus on reliability and cost-efficiency Contribute to agentic systems (e.g., planning, tool orchestration, multi-step workflows) and their integrations into customers' systems Set up evaluations – test datasets, metrics, benchmarks, and monitoring Help optimize systems across latency, cost, and quality Work with customers and the team to turn real-world problems into concrete technical solutions Your profile Enrolled in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or a related field Solid Python skills First hands-on experience with LLMs or ML tooling - from university, side projects, or internships Curiosity about what makes LLM applications reliable, safe, and scalable Ability to work independently and take ownership of your tasks Some bonus points to score Experience with agentic architectures (planning, memory, multi-agent coordination) Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, etc.) Proficient in German (written and spoken) Own projects on GitHub, open-source contributions, or technical writing Some of your benefits at 5Plus Real ownership: Work on AI solutions that go live quickly Learn from a small, experienced team with fast decision-making Flexible working hours that fit your study schedule, and freedom to choose your workplace Learning budget and support for conferences Option to write your Bachelor's or Master's thesis with us To plan an initial conversation quickly, please make sure your application contains all relevant documentation and information, you'd like to share with us. We look forward to meeting you! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
